name: Scraptrading
release_notes: Renamed the platform to Scraptrading, with the name now taken from a single setting so it can be changed in the admin panel at any time. Added Marathi, Bengali, Tamil and Punjabi alongside English, Hindi and Gujarati, with a language switcher reachable on a phone. Fixed the route compiler dropping any route whose constraint contained a quantifier, which had disabled the pincode lookup, and made in-site links and form actions relative so Content-Security-Policy cannot block a form submission.
